entry.author: Fire and Emergency NZ
entry.summary:
You can't just light a fire anywhere and anytime you want. Always check the fire season status and fire danger level, and follow the rules. Including -

• Before lighting any outdoor fires, go to www.checkitsalright.nz to check if it’s safe to do so.
• Always use the designated fire pits at DOC campsites.  
• Set up your cooker in a sheltered spot on a flat, stable surface outside, well away from anything that could catch on fire.  
• When you’re done, ensure your fire is fully extinguished. Douse your fire with water or be sure you’ve turned the gas off on your stove cooker.

Always check the local fire danger at checkitsalright.nz
